cases.sentence: Но так как ___ жил в дальнем квартале, то решили взять коляску.
cases.translation: But since the artist lived in a distant quarter, they decided to take a carriage.
cases.explain: Художник is the grammatical subject of жил (lived), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: В статье были укоры правительству и академии за то, что замечательный художник был лишен всякого ___ и помощи.
cases.translation: The article reproached the government and the academy because the remarkable artist had been deprived of any encouragement and help.
cases.explain: The verb лишен (deprived of) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: He ought to help the artist.
cases.explain: The verb помочь (to help) governs the dative case.
Картину is the direct object of the transitive verb видел (saw), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он писал под ___ итальянского профессора живописи этюды с натуры.
cases.translation: He painted studies from nature under the guidance of an Italian professor of painting.
cases.explain: The preposition под (under) in this static sense governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: В ___ были укоры правительству и академии.
cases.translation: The article contained reproaches to the government and the academy.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) indicating location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Вронский, писав с нее, любовался ее ___ и средневековостью.
cases.translation: Vronsky, painting from her, admired her beauty and her medieval quality.
cases.explain: The verb любоваться (to admire) governs the instrumental case.

reading.ru: Избранная Вронским роль с переездом в палаццо удалась совершенно, и, познакомившись через посредство Голенищева с некоторыми интересными лицами, первое время он был спокоен.
reading.question: How did Vronsky's chosen role work out after moving into the palazzo?
options: It succeeded completely, and he was calm at first
It caused a scandal in Rome
He abandoned it after a week
reading.correct: It succeeded completely, and he was calm at first
reading.explain: The text says his chosen role succeeded completely and he was at peace at first, after meeting interesting people through Golenishchev.

reading.ru: Средневековая итальянская жизнь в последнее время так прелестила Вронского, что он даже шляпу и плед через плечо стал носить по-средневековски, что очень шло к нему.
reading.question: How much had medieval Italian life charmed Vronsky?
options: Not at all; he ignored it
So much that he began wearing his hat and plaid in a medieval style
It made him want to leave Italy
reading.correct: So much that he began wearing his hat and plaid in a medieval style
reading.explain: The text says medieval Italian life so charmed Vronsky that he began wearing his hat and cloak in a medieval manner, which suited him.

reading.ru: «Ты видел картину Михайлова?» — сказал он, подавая ему только что полученную утром русскую газету и указывая на статью о русском художнике, жившем в том же городе и окончившем картину, о которой давно ходили слухи и которая вперед была куплена.
reading.question: What did Vronsky show Golenishchev along with his question about Mikhailov's picture?
options: A Russian newspaper just received that morning, with an article about the artist
reading.correct: A Russian newspaper just received that morning, with an article about the artist
reading.explain: The text says he handed Golenishchev a Russian newspaper just received that morning, pointing to an article about the Russian artist.

reading.ru: В статье были укоры правительству и академии за то, что замечательный художник был лишен всякого поощрения и помощи.
reading.question: What did the newspaper article reproach the government and the academy for?
options: Depriving a remarkable artist of any encouragement and help
reading.correct: Depriving a remarkable artist of any encouragement and help
reading.explain: The article reproached the government and academy because the remarkable artist had been deprived of encouragement and help.

reading.ru: «А мы живем и ничего не знаем», — сказал Рас Вронский, пришедшему к ним поутру Голенищеву.
reading.question: What did Vronsky remark to Golenishchev when he came to visit that morning?
options: That they live and know nothing about what is happening
That they should return to Russia at once
reading.correct: That they live and know nothing about what is happening
reading.explain: Vronsky said to Golenishchev, "And here we live and know nothing."

reading.ru: Христос представлен евреем со всем реализмом новой школы».
reading.question: How is Christ depicted in Mikhailov's painting according to the discussion?
options: As a Jew, with all the realism of the new school
As an angel in white robes
reading.correct: As a Jew, with all the realism of the new school
reading.explain: The text says Christ is portrayed as a Jew with all the realism of the new school.

reading.ru: А что же, правда, что этот Михайлов в такой бедности?
reading.question: What does Vronsky ask about Mikhailov's circumstances?
options: Whether it is true that Mikhailov is in such poverty
reading.correct: Whether it is true that Mikhailov is in such poverty
reading.explain: Vronsky asks whether it is true that Mikhailov is in such poverty, thinking he ought to help as a Russian patron.

reading.ru: Нельзя ли его попросить сделать портрет Анны Аркадьевны?
reading.question: What request does Vronsky make regarding Mikhailov?
options: To ask him to paint a portrait of Anna
To ask him to sell his medieval-themed collection
To ask him to teach Vronsky painting
To ask him to leave the city
reading.correct: To ask him to paint a portrait of Anna
reading.explain: Vronsky asks whether Mikhailov could be asked to paint a portrait of Anna Arkadyevna.

reading.ru: Красавица-кормилица, с которой Вронский писал голову для своей картины, была единственное тайное горе в жизни Анны.
reading.question: What was the secret sorrow in Anna's life at this time?
options: The beautiful wet-nurse from whom Vronsky painted a head for his picture
reading.correct: The beautiful wet-nurse from whom Vronsky painted a head for his picture
reading.explain: The text identifies the beautiful nurse, whose head Vronsky was painting, as Anna's one secret grief.

reading.ru: Но теперь является новый тип самородных вольнодумцев, которые вырастают, и не слыхав даже, что были законы нравственности, религии, что были авторитеты, а которые прямо вырастают в понятиях отрицания всего, то есть дикими.
reading.question: How does Golenishchev describe the new type of freethinker?
options: As people who grow up straight into notions of denying everything, never even having heard of moral or religious laws
As people devoted to religious tradition
As artists who reject modern science
reading.correct: As people who grow up straight into notions of denying everything, never even having heard of moral or religious laws
reading.explain: Golenishchev describes a new type of freethinker who grows up wild, straight into ideas of denying everything, without ever hearing of moral or religious authority.

reading.ru: «Знаете что?» — сказала Анна, уже давно осторожно переглядывавшаяся с Вронским и знавшая, что Вронского не интересовало образование этого художника, а занимала только мысль помочь ему и заказать ему портрет.
reading.question: What did Anna understand about what interested Vronsky regarding Mikhailov?
options: Vronsky was interested only in Mikhailov's education
Vronsky was not interested in the artist's education but only in helping him and commissioning a portrait
Vronsky wanted to compete with Mikhailov artistically
Vronsky wanted Mikhailov to move to Russia
reading.correct: Vronsky was not interested in the artist's education but only in helping him and commissioning a portrait
reading.explain: Anna, exchanging glances with Vronsky, knew he was not interested in the artist's education but only in the idea of helping him and commissioning a portrait.

reading.ru: Узнав от вышедшей к ним жены дворника, что Михайлов пускает в свою студию, но что он теперь у себя на квартире в двух шагах, они послали ее к нему с своими карточками, прося позволения видеть его картины.
reading.question: How did the group learn where to find Mikhailov and seek permission to see his pictures?
options: They asked a policeman for directions
The doorkeeper's wife told them he was at his apartment nearby, and they sent her with their cards
They read it in the newspaper
Golenishchev already had an appointment arranged
reading.correct: The doorkeeper's wife told them he was at his apartment nearby, and they sent her with their cards
reading.explain: The doorkeeper's wife told them Mikhailov was at his apartment two steps away, so they sent her to him with their cards requesting to see his pictures.
